excluded.name: PRICE_PER_SQFT
excluded.reason: Target-derived (price ÷ area). EDA diagnostic only; using it as an input would be direct leakage.

excluded.name: READY_TO_MOVE
excluded.reason: Exact complement of UNDER_CONSTRUCTION in 100% of rows (EDA-verified). Its information is fully preserved by UNDER_CONSTRUCTION; keeping both adds pure collinearity, especially for linear models.

excluded.name: ADDRESS (raw)
excluded.reason: Free text identifier-like field; its usable content is extracted as LOCALITY + CITY inside the pipeline. Raw text would memorise listings and cannot generalise.

excluded.name: Target encoding of CITY/LOCALITY
excluded.reason: Would require out-of-fold fitting discipline and risks leakage; frequency counts + one-hot/native handling provide the location signal safely.

excluded.name: Target clipping / winsorising
excluded.reason: The expensive tail contains genuine luxury properties (EDA §Q6). Skew is handled by the log1p target transform, not by deleting or capping prices.

features.name: POSTED_BY
features.purpose: Listing source (Owner/Dealer/Builder) — channel effects on asking price

features.name: UNDER_CONSTRUCTION
features.purpose: Construction status; also carries READY_TO_MOVE information (exact complement)

features.name: RERA
features.purpose: RERA registration status — regulatory/trust signal; also a risk-score input downstream

features.name: BHK_NO.
features.purpose: Bedroom count — strong monotone price relationship (Spearman ~0.50)

features.name: BHK_OR_RK
features.purpose: Configuration type (BHK vs RK). Quasi-constant (99.9% BHK) — flagged in selection

features.name: SQUARE_FT
features.purpose: Property area — strongest single price signal (Spearman ~0.57)

features.name: RESALE
features.purpose: Resale vs new listing status

features.fitted: YES — centroids and kept-city list from training split only
features.name: CITY
features.purpose: City-level market effect; grouping keeps cardinality bounded and unseen cities safe
features.source: derived from ADDRESS last segment; state label repaired (Maharashtra→Mumbai), corrupt label (Lalitpur) reassigned by nearest fitted centroid, rare cities grouped to Other

features.fitted: YES — one-hot min_frequency=25 / native fallback, training split only
features.name: LOCALITY
features.purpose: Micro-market effect — the strongest location granularity available; high cardinality handled by frequency grouping

features.name: LATITUDE
features.purpose: Geographic position (locality-level granularity — EDA finding)
features.source: cleaned column (already repaired from the raw swap); invalid values at transform time replaced by fitted city centroid

features.name: LONGITUDE
features.purpose: Geographic position (locality-level)
features.source: cleaned column (already repaired); same fallback as LATITUDE

features.name: SQUARE_FT_PER_BHK
features.purpose: Spaciousness per bedroom — separates large-family homes from luxury area
features.source: derived: SQUARE_FT / BHK_NO. from prediction-time inputs

features.name: LOG_SQUARE_FT
features.purpose: Linearises the area–price relationship (log-area Pearson ~0.60 vs 0.57 Spearman raw)

features.fitted: YES — centroids from training split only
features.name: DIST_TO_CITY_CENTROID
features.purpose: Centrality within the city — prime vs peripheral location proxy
features.source: derived: Euclidean degrees from the property's coordinates to its CITY centroid

features.name: CITY_FREQ
features.purpose: Market thickness per city; unseen city = 0
features.source: derived: training-row count of the (grouped) CITY

features.name: LOCALITY_FREQ
features.purpose: Evidence strength for the locality estimate; unseen locality = 0 (a confidence signal, not a price signal)
features.source: derived: training-row count of the LOCALITY

features.name: LAT_LON_INTERACTION
features.purpose: EXPERIMENTAL — diagonal geographic gradient for linear models; retained for training-stage ablation

features.name: SQFT_BAND
features.purpose: Size segment — lets models price size tiers non-linearly and aids interpretability
features.source: derived: fixed domain bands XS<600, S 600–1000, M 1000–1500, L 1500–2500, XL>2500 sq ft

features.name: BHK_CONFIG
features.purpose: Configuration identity as a single category (captures RK vs BHK at the same bedroom count)

features.fitted: YES — KMeans fitted on training coordinates only
features.name: GEO_CLUSTER
features.purpose: EXPERIMENTAL — data-driven geographic neighbourhoods that cross administrative city boundaries; retained for training-stage ablation
features.source: derived: KMeans cluster id (k=32) of (LATITUDE, LONGITUDE)

status: Produced by the preprocessing & feature-engineering stage. Core features are identical to project schema v1.1.0 plus its Stage-3b extended set; SQFT_BAND, BHK_CONFIG, GEO_CLUSTER and LAT_LON_INTERACTION are additions of this stage (GEO_CLUSTER and LAT_LON_INTERACTION flagged experimental). Any change requires a version bump and refit.

target.name: TARGET(PRICE_IN_LACS)
target.transform: log1p at modelling layer (train skew 17.6 raw on cleaned data); never clipped
